description: Access to ADEME datasets (French ecological transition agency) - data on energy, environment, waste, transport, housing

tool_signatures.name: aggregate_data
tool_signatures.description: Aggregate dataset rows by 1-3 columns with optional metrics (sum, avg, min, max, count). Defaults to counting unique values.

filters.description: Column filters as key-value pairs. Key format: column_key + suffix (see server instructions for available suffixes). Example: { "nom_search": "Jean", "age_lte": "30", "ville_eq": "Paris" }

datasetId.description: The unique dataset ID obtained from search_datasets tool

column.description: The column key to aggregate (use keys from describe_dataset)

metric.description: Aggregation metric to perform on the column. Available operations are: sum, avg, min, max, count.

aggregation.description: The aggregation specification to perform on the specified column. Use keys from describe_dataset. If not provided, defaults to counting unique values in the aggregation column.

aggregationColumns.description: List of column keys to aggregate (use keys from describe_dataset, min 1 column, max 3 columns)

total.description: The total number of rows in the dataset

datasetId.description: The dataset ID that was aggregated

requestUrl.description: Direct URL to API results in JSON format (must be included in responses for citation and direct access to aggregated view)

total.description: Total number of rows aggregated for this column

columnValue.description: The value of the aggregated column (string or number)

metricValue.description: The value of the aggregation metric (e.g., sum, avg) on the selected column

aggregations.description: Nested aggregation results when multiple columns are specified (max 3 levels deep)

nonRepresented.description: The number of non-represented rows for this column

totalAggregated.description: Total number of different values aggregated for this column

aggregations.description: Array of aggregation results for each specified column (limited to 20 rows)

nonRepresented.description: The number of non-represented rows in the dataset, 0 if totalAggregated is less than 20, otherwise the number of non-represented rows

totalAggregated.description: The total number of different values aggregated across all specified columns

tool_signatures.name: calculate_metric
tool_signatures.description: Calculate a single metric (avg, sum, min, max, stats, value_count, cardinality, percentiles) on a dataset column. Supports filters to restrict the calculation to a subset of rows.

metric.description: Metric to calculate. Available: avg, sum, min, max (for numbers); min, max, cardinality, value_count (for strings); value_count (for others); stats returns count/min/max/avg/sum; percentiles returns distribution.

filters.description: Column filters as key-value pairs. Key format: column_key + suffix (see server instructions for available suffixes). Example: { "nom_search": "Jean", "age_lte": "30", "ville_eq": "Paris" }

fieldKey.description: The column key to calculate the metric on (use keys from describe_dataset)

percents.description: Comma-separated percentages for percentiles metric (default: "1,5,25,50,75,95,99"). Only used when metric is "percentiles".

datasetId.description: The unique dataset ID obtained from search_datasets or provided by the user

total.description: Total number of rows included in the calculation

value.description: The calculated metric value (number for most metrics, object for stats/percentiles)

fieldKey.description: The column key that was queried

datasetId.description: The dataset ID that was queried

tool_signatures.name: describe_dataset
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed metadata for a dataset: column schema, sample rows, license, spatial/temporal coverage.

datasetId.description: The unique dataset ID obtained from search_datasets or provided by the user

id.description: Unique dataset Id (required for search_data tools)

link.description: Link to the dataset page (must be included in responses as citation source)

slug.description: Human-readable unique identifier for the dataset, used in URLs

count.description: Total number of data rows in the dataset

origin.description: Source or provider of the dataset

enum.description: List of all possible values for this column

labels.description: Object mapping actual data values (keys) to human-readable labels (values). Use keys for filters.

concept.description: Semantic concept associated with the column

schema.description: Dataset column schema with types and metadata

license.description: Dataset license information (must be included in responses)

summary.description: A brief summary of the dataset content

description.description: A markdown description of the dataset content

sampleLines.description: Array of 3 sample data rows showing real values from the dataset. Use these examples to understand exact formatting, casing, and typical values for _eq and _search filters.

tool_signatures.name: get_field_values
tool_signatures.description: List distinct values of a specific column. Useful to discover what values exist before filtering, or to populate a filter list.

size.description: Number of values to return (default: 10, max: 1000)

sort.description: Sort order for the values (default: asc)

query.description: Optional text to filter values (prefix/substring match within this column)

fieldKey.description: The column key to get values for (use keys from describe_dataset)

datasetId.description: The unique dataset ID obtained from search_datasets or provided by the user

values.description: Array of distinct values for the specified column

fieldKey.description: The column key that was queried

datasetId.description: The dataset ID that was queried

tool_signatures.name: search_data
tool_signatures.description: Search for data rows in a dataset using full-text search (query) or precise column filters. Returns matching rows and a filtered view URL.

next.description: URL from a previous search_data response to fetch the next page of results. When provided, all other parameters (query, filters, select, size) are ignored since the URL already contains them.

size.description: Number of rows to return per page (default: 10, max: 50). Increase when you know you need more results upfront to avoid multiple pagination round-trips.

query.description: French keywords for full-text search across all dataset columns (simple keywords, not sentences). Do not use with filters parameter. Examples: "Jean Dupont", "Paris", "2025"

select.description: Optional comma-separated list of column keys to include in the results. Useful when the dataset has many columns to reduce output size. If not provided, all columns are returned. Use column keys from describe_dataset. Format: column1,column2,column3 (No spaces after commas). Example: "nom,age,ville"

filters.description: Column filters as key-value pairs. Key format: column_key + suffix (see server instructions for available suffixes). Example: { "nom_search": "Jean", "age_lte": "30", "ville_eq": "Paris" }

datasetId.description: The unique dataset ID obtained from search_datasets or provided by the user

next.description: URL to fetch the next page of results. Absent when there are no more results. Pass this value as the next input parameter to get the next page.

count.description: Number of data rows matching the search criteria and filters

items.description: Data row object containing column keys as object keys with their values, plus _score field indicating search relevance (higher score = more relevant)

lines.description: An array of data rows matching the search criteria (up to the requested size).

datasetId.description: The dataset ID that was searched

filteredViewUrl.description: Link to view the filtered dataset results in table format (must be included in responses for citation and direct access to filtered view)

tool_signatures.name: search_datasets
tool_signatures.description: Full-text search for datasets by French keywords. Returns matching datasets with ID, title, summary, and page link.

query.description: French keywords for full-text search (simple keywords, not sentences). Examples: "élus", "DPE", "entreprises", "logement social"

count.description: Number of datasets matching the full-text search criteria

id.description: Unique dataset ID (required for describe_dataset and search_data tools)

link.description: Link to the dataset page (must be included in responses as citation source)

summary.description: A summary of the dataset content

datasets.description: An array of the top 20 datasets matching the full-text search criteria.
